shots.focal_element: Front-facing presenter seated at a desk against a plain textured wall, overlaid first by a full-width product-name title and then by a name/role lower third
shots.transition_other: video start (anchors give no incoming transition for the first shot)
shots.typography: Tall condensed bold sans-serif in all caps with tight tracking for the title and name (guess, low confidence: a condensed grotesk display face); the role line is a much smaller condensed caps line with slightly looser tracking. Words wipe on left-to-right with the leading letters briefly in an accent colour before settling, and wipe off left-to-right.
shots.what_happens: Static locked-off medium shot of the presenter speaking to camera (words w0-w35, the pain statement and product introduction). From frame 0 the title 'BREEZE PROSPECTING AGENT' wipes on across the frame centre over her torso (complete by ~0.5 s), holds, and is wiped off left-to-right around 4.5 s just before w17 'With'. Around 7.0 s (near w24 'AI') a lower third builds bottom-left: the name types/wipes on, a small organic brand blob shape pops in beside it, then the role line wipes in under it; the lower third holds and dissolves out by ~11.5 s. A small HubSpot logo bug sits top-right throughout.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a full-bleed talking-head clip with a centred uppercase condensed title revealed by a left-to-right clip-path wipe (accent-coloured leading edge) at t=0 and wiped off at ~4.5 s, then a bottom-left lower third whose name and role lines clip-wipe on with a 0.3 s stagger beside a popping blob shape and fade out at ~11 s, with a persistent corner logo bug.

shots.focal_element: Presenter in a three-quarter angle on the left third, with short kinetic benefit phrases occupying the empty right side of the frame
shots.typography: Same condensed bold all-caps sans as the title in s001, smaller and right-aligned/right-of-centre; 'CONNECTS WITH YOUR DATA' breaks onto two stacked lines. Each phrase wipes on with an accent-coloured leading edge and wipes off left-to-right.
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a second camera angle (three-quarter, shallow depth of field, window light on the right). Three benefit phrases appear in sequence, each synced to the voice-over: 'SIMPLE TO USE' with w36-w39, 'CONNECTS WITH YOUR DATA' with w40-w44, 'FAST RESULTS' with w45-w49; each replaces the previous with a wipe-off/wipe-on. Between the second and third phrase a thin curved accent line sweeps across the frame from left to right (~14.0-15.0 s), passing behind/through the text. She says 'Let's take a look' (w50-w53) as the last phrase wipes away; the final sampled frame (16.5 s) already shows the next shot's tablet, so the cut lands at the shot boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a talking-head clip, cycle three right-side uppercase phrases (one per spoken clause, timed to word indices w36, w40, w45) each revealed and removed by a left-to-right clip-path wipe, and animate an SVG stroke line (stroke-dashoffset) sweeping across the frame between phrases two and three.

shots.focal_element: Top-down live-action view of a large touchscreen tablet lying on a wooden desk, showing the HubSpot Prospecting Agent Overview page, with the presenter's hands gesturing over and tapping it
on_screen_text: Let's put your prospecting efforts on auto-pilot
When a lead submits a form or visits a website, the agent will compose and send personalized outreach.
The agent will find leads who stopped engaging, then compose and send personalized outreach.
Select any contact you want the agent to research, then it will compose and send personalized outreach.
After you've enrolled contacts, they will show up here
shots.typography: Real product UI typography (HubSpot app): geometric/humanist sans, sentence case, semibold card headings, regular small body copy, small tag-style buttons; no motion-graphic type is added in this shot.
shots.what_happens: Long (~15.5 s) locked-off overhead shot of the tablet: the UI itself stays on the same Overview page throughout, while the presenter's hands point at and gesture over it to illustrate the narration (w54-w101): she points to the Overview page, spreads her hands across the three enrollment cards while listing the three ways to enroll contacts (w71-w86), and points at the Enrollments area/empty state while mentioning today's email activity and agent-written emails awaiting review (w87-w101). No visible UI state change; the 3 code-detected events in this shot are most likely the hand movements. The last sampled frame (32.0 s) already shows the side-angle presenter of s004.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a static high-resolution UI screenshot into a tablet frame on a top-down wood-desk plate and film or rotoscope hands over it, keeping the screen content static and letting hand gestures point to each card in sync with the voice-over word indices.

shots.focal_element: Presenter in a three-quarter angle looking down at and tapping the tablet built into the desk
shots.what_happens: Short cutaway (~2.7 s) from the same three-quarter angle as s002, now with the presenter looking down and tapping the desk-embedded tablet while saying w102-w112 ('So you have these emails that the agent created for you'). The last sampled frame (34.5 s) already shows the top-down tablet with a different UI view (a list of enrollments with summary metrics), which belongs to the next shot; its text is too small to read here.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 2.5-3 s side-angle B-roll clip of the presenter interacting with the device between two top-down UI shots, hard-cut on both ends, to bridge a UI page change.
